heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 4
text: If volume is 72π and radius 3, height is 72π/(9π)=8.

heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 5
text: An open-top cylinder needs one circular base plus its curved side: πr²+2πrh.

heading: LATERAL SURFACE
text: Unroll the curved surface into a rectangle of width 2πr and height h.

heading: WHY THE FORMULAS WORK
text: Volume equals base area times height; total area adds two disks and one unrolled rectangle.

heading: COMMON MISTAKES
text: Do not use diameter as radius, forget the square, or include two bases for an open-top cylinder.

heading: EXAM STRATEGY
text: Write the formula first, substitute radius not diameter, and leave answers in exact π form when requested.

heading: QUICK CHECK
text: Radius 2, height 3 gives volume 12π. Radius 3, height 4 gives closed surface area 42π.

heading: RECAP AND NEXT STEP
text: V=πr²h; S=2πr²+2πrh. Practice 18 questions, review 18 solutions, take five tests, and use bilingual full lesson.
